ns2:section.sectionText: ATTENTION: You must register for four (4) hours of EOL 560 during the fall semester only. The class will continue through the spring, but credit is only given during the fall semester. This is a requirement for the class. Class will meet the following Weds. from 7 - 10pm, in room 323: Sept 7, Oct 26 and Nov 30. The class will also continue through spring 06 on the following dates: Jan 25, Feb 22 and April 5. You will not need to register for the spring semester. You will receive a DFR (Deferred Grade) which will be changed when you complete your portfolio in the spring. Dr. Swanson will change your grade to S (Satisfactory). Please call 244-6781 if you have any questions.
